# LSD Super Pack Modification

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

[Partial] Add one steel plate to both sides of the split carrier and reassemble with RTV sealant. [t1915]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. Remove the 3rd member from the axle housing.
2. Measure the backlash of the ring and pinion gears.
3. Remove the carrier assembly from inside the 3rd member.
4. Split the carrier apart to access the friction plates.
5. Add one steel plate (not a friction disc) to both sides of the split carrier.
6. Reassemble the carrier, ensuring threads are clean and dry with Loctite on bolts.
7. [Partial] Set backlash back to original measurements without over-tightening to avoid noise or gear scaling.
8. Install the 3rd member into the housing using RTV sealant instead of a gasket.

_Procedure reported by [t1915]._

## Parts

- [Partial] RTV sealant: Black Right Stuff or grey Permatex for housing gasket replacement [t1915]
- Steel friction plate: One steel, non-friction disc per side [t1915]

## Tips & gotchas

- Use plain 80W-90 gear oil after assembly. [t1915]
- Expect some tire chirping around tight corners due to increased resistance. [t1915]
